title: Crossref documentation: Retraction Watch data access
summary: Crossref documentation for the Retraction Watch Database as openly available correction/retraction metadata via API and CSV/Git workflow.

source_payload.source_type: official/institutional HTML source or source-index search result where dynamic page text was not fully exposed
source_payload.copyability: not embedded; exact URL, retrieval time, web reference, and line/search locators recorded; archive/hash pass deferred
line_locators_used: L123-L127: research can be corrected/retracted; Crossref acquired RWDB in Sept 2023 and made it publicly available; data updated every working day; EOCs/corrections included but less comprehensive.
L128-L140: access via Crossref REST API or CSV Git repository; updated once per working day.
extraction_notes: One-pass source extraction for rev0008 denominator-visibility records.
Dynamic pages are represented with search-result locators where direct open returned sparse app shell text.

handling_notes: Registry/preregistration/retraction/comment platforms can expose living researchers and sensitive clinical research; use claim-status discipline and avoid shame framing.
Do not infer misconduct, nonpublication, or failed results from absence or from a single post-publication comment without source-backed status review.
